name: Instant note
spotted_by: Any gym miss stated at 80% or more
lesson: Two lines: the answer, why the wrong one tempted you, what a calibrated call looked like
evidence: Design rule: a miss below 80% is expected and gets no note

name: Autopsy
spotted_by: Any real prediction missed at 85% or more, plus 1 in 5 confident hits
lesson: Four questions: what I knew, what I missed, luck or judgment, one rule for next time
evidence: Design rule: hits are sampled too so right-for-the-wrong-reason is caught

name: Overconfident at the top
spotted_by: Calls stated at 90 to 99%: average confidence 10 or more points above hit rate over the last 40
lesson: The price of 99: what a miss at 99% costs, and the equivalent-bet wheel
repair_drill: 15 top-band calls, each checked against the wheel before you commit
evidence: Sim D: false alarm on a calibrated player 8% in 150 calls; catches typical overconfidence in a median of 46 calls

name: Underconfident
spotted_by: Calls stated at 60 to 80%: hit rate 12 or more points above average confidence over the last 60
lesson: You know more than you say: the points left on the table
evidence: Sim (trigger_sim.py): false alarm on a calibrated player 9.6% over 150 calls looked at every session end; catches typical underconfidence 95.8% in a median of 63 calls. 10 points gave 19.7% false alarms

name: Fence-sitting
spotted_by: More than 30% of the last 60 calls stated at 50 to 55% while your hit rate on them is 65% or more
repair_drill: 15 calls with the 50 to 55% zone locked
cleared_when: Under 20% of the next 60 calls in that zone
evidence: Sim B: always saying 50% earns 0 points a call

name: Soft questions
spotted_by: The checker rejects 3 or more of your last 10 journal predictions
lesson: Could a stranger score this? The clairvoyant test
repair_drill: Rewrite 5 vague predictions until each passes

name: Ranges too narrow
spotted_by: 90% ranges: fewer than 30 of the last 40 contain the truth
lesson: Widen, then narrow: test each end of the range on its own
repair_drill: 10 ranges built one bound at a time
cleared_when: Next 40 ranges: 33 to 38 contain the truth
evidence: Binomial per 40 ranges: fires on a calibrated player 0.1%, on a 70%-coverage player 69%

name: Ranges too wide
spotted_by: 90% ranges: 39 or 40 of the last 40 contain the truth and average width is over twice the reference
lesson: Wide is not safe: what the interval score charges for width
cleared_when: Next 40 ranges: 33 to 38 contain the truth
evidence: Sim E: always-wide ranges score 1.26 to 2.42 times worse than honest ones

name: Chain blindness
spotted_by: Predictions that need 2 or more things to all happen: stated 15 or more points above hit rate over the last 15
lesson: Multiply the chain: three 80% steps make 51%

name: Planning fallacy
spotted_by: Predictions about your own tasks and deadlines: stated 15 or more points above hit rate over the last 20
lesson: Your own base rate: your record on this kind of task
repair_drill: Re-forecast every open task prediction starting from your record

name: Base-rate neglect
spotted_by: Forecasts 25 or more points from the recorded base rate with no evidence logged, scoring worse than the base rate over the last 15
lesson: Start outside: reference class first, adjust second
cleared_when: Next 15 such forecasts carry logged evidence
evidence: Chang 2016: comparison classes were the principle most tied to accuracy

name: Frozen forecasts
spotted_by: 5 or more open predictions older than 7 days with coach-flagged news and no update
lesson: Small steps: update when the evidence moves
repair_drill: 5 evidence-stream problems, then update the flagged predictions
cleared_when: No flagged prediction left un-updated for 7 days
evidence: Atanasov 2020: frequent updates were tied to better accuracy

name: Whiplash
spotted_by: Half or more of your updates above 25 points reversed within 14 days, over the last 10 such updates
lesson: What is this news worth? Likelihood ratios
cleared_when: Next 10 large updates: fewer than 3 reversed
evidence: Atanasov 2020: larger updates were tied to worse accuracy

name: Rewritten memory
spotted_by: Memory check: your recalled forecast is 10 or more points closer to the outcome than the recorded one, on average over 10 checks
lesson: What you actually believed: hindsight in your own record
repair_drill: Recall 10 old forecasts before seeing them
cleared_when: Average drift within 5 points over the next 10 checks
evidence: Drift is counted toward the outcome; 10 points over 10 checks is set from the simulation in design/balance-report.md 5e

name: Domain blind spot
spotted_by: One domain: your edge points are below zero over the last 30 resolved predictions
lesson: Defer here for now: use the base rate, then rebuild
repair_drill: Coach-built set from your own misses in that domain
cleared_when: Edge at or above zero over the next 30 in that domain
evidence: Sim F: zero edge means the baseline alone would have done as well

name: Round-number habit
spotted_by: After Unit 10: over 90% of the last 100 calls on multiples of 10
lesson: Finer grain: 60 or 65 is a real difference
repair_drill: 20 calls on the 1% dial under the sharp rule
cleared_when: Under 70% of the next 100 calls on multiples of 10
evidence: Sim B: rounding to tens costs 0.3 points a call; Friedman 2018: coarsening consistently lost accuracy

name: Missed days
spotted_by: 2 or more missed days in the last 7
lesson: Not a judgment lesson: the session shrinks to a 3-minute minimum
evidence: Economy sim at one prediction a day: at 60% attendance the first bias map takes 179 days instead of 124
